topic: Architecture alignment for Payments V2 gateway migration

messages.text: Hey team, regarding the UI integration debate: Stripe Payment Elements gives us in-app custom branding and iframe isolation for PCI SAQ-A eligibility, whereas Hosted Checkout forces a domain redirect that dropped conversion by 4.2% in EU testing.
Agreed. Keeping users in our app checkout funnel is crucial for mobile conversion. Let's proceed with Elements.
Dave Chen confirmed on Slack: We are pushing the production cutover date back to January 10, 2027 to allow QA team time for penetration testing.
